facts.fact: Couples research wedding venues and vendors for 9 to 18 months before they book, according to the guide.
facts.quote: Your customer is researching for 9 to 18 months before they book

facts.fact: The guide states that most wedding venues need 4-8 inquiries to produce one booked event.
facts.quote: Most venues need 4-8 inquiries to produce one booked event

facts.fact: The guide gives a per-booking value of $15K-$45K for a wedding venue.
facts.quote: For a venue, $15K-$45K per booking.

facts.fact: The guide gives a per-booking value of $4K-$25K for an event planner.
facts.quote: For a planner, $4K-$25K.

facts.fact: The guide gives a per-booking value of $2K-$10K for specialty services such as photographers and florists.
facts.quote: For specialty services (photographers, florists at-scale), $2K-$10K.

facts.fact: The guide estimates Google Ads cost per inquiry at $25-$90 for wedding venues.
facts.quote: Cost per inquiry: typically $25-$90 for wedding venues, $15-$65 for event planners.

facts.fact: The guide estimates Meta (Instagram and Facebook) ads cost per inquiry at $35-$120 for wedding venues.
facts.quote: Cost per inquiry: $35-$120 for venues, $25-$80 for planners, with significant variance based on creative quality.

facts.fact: Wedding directory premium placement and lead-gen packages typically cost $200-$800 per month per directory.
facts.quote: directory premium placement and lead-gen packages typically run $200-$800/month per directory

facts.fact: Some wedding venues pay $1,500 or more per month for top directory placement in major markets.
facts.quote: with some venues paying $1,500+ in major markets for top placement.

facts.fact: Wedding directory listings often show 30-100 options for a couple's criteria.
facts.quote: Directory listings often surface 30-100 options for a couple's criteria

facts.fact: The guide says local SEO work such as a simple audit or schema markup costs a few hundred dollars per year.
facts.quote: A few hundred dollars per year for a simple local SEO audit or schema markup work.

facts.fact: Wedding show and bridal expo booths cost $800-$3,500 per show, not counting staff time and giveaways.
facts.quote: Cost: $800-$3,500 per show booth, plus staff time and giveaway costs.

facts.fact: The guide says expos can produce 3-10 bookings per show for venues, based on its own estimate.
facts.quote: expos can produce 3-10 bookings per show for venues and similar for planners.

facts.fact: Adwave, the vendor publishing the guide, runs connected TV (CTV) subscriptions starting at $50.
facts.quote: Adwave runs subscriptions from $50, with most venues testing CTV at $800-$2,000 monthly budgets.

facts.fact: Venues testing connected TV advertising typically use monthly budgets of $800-$2,000.
facts.quote: with most venues testing CTV at $800-$2,000 monthly budgets.

facts.fact: CTV CPM typically falls between $15 and $35, with an average around $25, according to the guide.
facts.quote: CPM typically lands in the $15-$35 range with an average around $25.

facts.fact: The page recommends aiming for 3-5 impressions per household over a 2-3 week CTV flight.
